# Minecraft 1.8.9 Packet Reference — llms.txt
# https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/

> Searchable reference for all 105 Minecraft 1.8.9 network packets — fields, wire encoding, MCP classes, real client examples and anti-cheat notes.

## Docs
- [Home](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/)
- [All Packets](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/)
- [Module Index](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/modules/)
- [Module Analysis](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/analysis/)

## Protocol states
- Handshaking: C00Handshake
- Login: C00PacketLoginStart, C01PacketEncryptionResponse, S00PacketDisconnect, S01PacketEncryptionRequest, S02PacketLoginSuccess, S03PacketEnableCompression
- Status: C00PacketServerQuery, C01PacketPing, S00PacketServerInfo, S01PacketPong
- Play: 23 serverbound + 71 clientbound packets, see /packets/ index.

## API-ish
- Sitemap: https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/sitemap.xml
- Packet pages: https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/<PacketId>/
